purpose: codebook calibration and independent human agreement only; not performance scoring

reviewer_blinding.source_excerpt_secret_redaction: sensitive-key literals, PEM private keys, and recognizable provider tokens redacted; public default credential strings may remain for rule assessment

selection.rare_rule_policy: rules with fewer than five calibration candidates are excluded from the pilot and listed; they remain available for later census/special handling
selection.review_history_limit: All calibration target commits must exist. The actual first parent/diff is required only for diff-dependent rules; commit-message-format and missing-bug-reference use the exact target commit message and remain eligible without a parent. Detector base=null/root-diff fallbacks are never used. This is a context-availability-limited pool, not a claim that other findings are semantically false.
selection.round_robin_rule_order: lexical rule_id order; first pass one item/repository across a family; second pass permits another item/repository if needed
